title: Workshop management and facilitation
text:
Workshop Management and Facilitation
 WHY ARE WE HOLDING THE WORKSHOP
 From hoping it will happen to making it happen
• Don’t engage in the training as a procedure
• Implementation Quality is the key to better results
• Effective Implementation involves:
 • identifying approaches that work; and
 • delivering them sustainably, at scale,
 • in ways that maximise their effectiveness
 • Implementation Support involves
 • Identifying all bottlenecks and mitigating
 • in a tailored ‘hands-on’ way
 • to deliver reforms aspirations
 The Implementation Gap
The Implementation Gap is the gap between
• What is proposed but not adopted into practice
• Wat is adopted into practice but not practised as intended (fidelity)
• What is practised as intended but not practised at scale or sustained
The key to bridging the gap is ensuring research informed:
• Opportunity to practice
• Sustained and embedded capacity-building
• Sustained and embedded Resources
• Sufficient time to translate initiative to scale & make it sustainable.
